title: Darth Vader
description: Years before Darth Vader's name made worlds temble, he was a small boy on Tatooine named Anakin Skywalker. Qui-Gon Jinn realized Anakin's Force potential and petitioned the Jedi Council to train the boy. After Qui=Gon died fighting Darth Maul during the Battle of Naboo, Qui-Gon's Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi promised Anakin he would train him.
